examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A relative range (`Last 15 minutes`) that stays relative: the value is `{ type: 'relative', amount, unit }`, re-resolved against the clock on every query. The Relative tab has a custom duration and unit on top and the quick ranges below (two columns when there is room); the Absolute tab has the month grid with start and end date and time (type a time or pick one from the 30-minute list under the field); the panel is as thin as the calendar and names the zone in a read-only line. Nothing commits until Apply. On a phone the panel opens as a full-width sheet from the bottom of the screen.

examples.name: Absolute
examples.summary: `range-selector-mode="absolute-only"` with a `max`: only the grid and the date and time fields, the trigger prints the range in the zone with its UTC offset, and Apply refuses an end before the start or past the limit with an inline message.

examples.name: RelativeOnly
examples.summary: `range-selector-mode="relative-only"` with the product's own quick ranges, for a metrics interval that is always measured back from now.
